marks.gloss_en: אימר דאמר רבי מאיר לחששא, לאחזוקינהו מי אמר? (= p_rm_lechashasha)
R' Meir said it [of priests] as a concern; did he say it to establish them [as blemishers]?
אמר ליה רב אסי לרב אשי: והא תנא דבי מנשה: אין עד מפי עד כשר אלא לעדות האשה!
Rav Asi: hearsay testimony is not accepted for a firstborn ('forbids')
תני: אלא לעדות שהאשה כשרה לה בלבד (= p_tni_shehaisha_kshera_lah)
teach [the baraita]: only for testimony for which a woman is valid
מתקיף לה מר בר רב אשי: מאי שנא מההוא גברא דאוגר ליה חמרא לחבריה ... ואמר אביי: מה לו לשקר במקום עדים לא אמרינן
הכי השתא?! התם ודאי איכא מיא, הכא ודאי שדי ביה מומא? חששא הוא, ובמקום חששא אמרינן מה לו לשקר (= p_bimkom_chashasha_amrinan)
there, there was certainly water; here, did he certainly blemish it? it is a concern, and where there is a concern we do say 'why would he lie'
והלכתא: עד מפי עד כשר לעדות בכור
Mareimar called him: 'Yeimar who permits the firstborn'
R' Ile'a: it was not presumed a firstborn, and one came and said 'it is a firstborn and its blemish is with it' -- he is believed
the mishna: a woman who said 'I was a married woman and I am divorced' is believed, for the mouth that forbade is the mouth that permitted
for were it for that [to permit it falsely], he would have made a visible blemish in it and eaten it
Rava [on the hired donkey that died on the Nehar Pekod road, the renter claiming there was no water]: why would he lie? had he wished he could have said 'I went by the Neresh road'
R' Tzadok had a firstborn; he put barley for it in wicker baskets, and while it ate its lip split
Rabban Gamliel: wait until the shield-bearers come up to the study hall
Rabban Gamliel: Yehoshua, stand on your feet and they will testify against you
Rabban Gamliel stood expounding while R' Yehoshua stood on his feet, until all the people murmured and said to Chutzpit the meturgeman: stop! -- and he stopped
אף אנן נמי תנינא: a priest is believed to say 'I showed this firstborn and it is blemished' -- is that not because a matter apt to be revealed, people do not lie about?
a priest is believed to say 'an Israelite gave me this firstborn with its blemish'
התם הוא דקדשים בחוץ לא אכיל, אבל הכא כיון דחשידי -- חשידי: there [the mishna's priest] does not eat sacred meat outside; here, since they are suspect, they are suspect
מתיב רב שיזבי: the untrusted agent told 'buy from one who is trusted / who tithes' is not believed -- why? say: any matter apt to be revealed, people do not lie about!
the mishna (Demai 4:5): one who tells someone untrusted about tithe 'buy for me from one who is trusted' or 'from one who tithes' -- he is not believed
שאני התם דאית ליה לאשתמוטי -- there it is different, for he has [a way] to extricate himself (36a.21-36b.1)
the mishna: a priest is believed to say 'I showed this firstborn and it is blemished'
